verdict.rationale: A manual review queue is a fair question for a fraud-prevention product, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only API submission, decision retrieval, webhooks and Decision Center policy configuration. Nothing documents an analyst review queue showing customer history, signals or similar cases. The Decision Center policy mention is an adjacent control, not a review queue.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, flagged transactions land in a review queue that shows the full context — customer history, signals, similar cases — so I can decide quickly and consistently
